scope.producerTelemetryLimit: Producer report bytes/work fields are advisory and are not used as admission authority

scope.completenessLimit: Immutable invocation/input facts only; full per-family original field/profile/source-state, model/paper/layout, dependencies, editable/live/output, native and independent semantic qualification remain open
